retrievalProfile.description: A gritty, high-contrast urban collage featuring central figures against a brick backdrop with heavy, outlined display typography and heraldic motifs.

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-person portrait collage set against an urban brick building, featuring a prominent blue street sign, heavy block-style header text with wing motifs, and a large, stylized title at the bottom flanked by heraldic lion silhouettes.
coreVisualRelationships: Central trio of figures overlapping a gritty urban background
Top-aligned header text balanced by bottom-aligned title text
Street sign providing a secondary focal point in the upper left
Heraldic lion silhouettes framing the lower title text
coreInvariants: Heavy black outlines on all display typography
Brick wall texture as the primary background element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three men in the mid-ground, waist-up, occupying the central 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the large, heavy title text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top header, down through the central figures, to the large title and advisory logo at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense and filled with textures and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and shadows providing high contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright whites and light grays in clothing and text outlines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant blue from the street sign and red outlines on the header.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blue and red elements against a gritty, desaturated brick background.

letterConstructionRules: Thick black outlines with secondary red or white inner strokes
Squat, wide proportions for display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Header 'U' and 'P' integrated into a rectangular frame with horizontal wing bars
Title letters featuring sharp, thorn-like extensions
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display sans-serif paired with a clean, small-scale geometric sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and vertical presence.
Matches the wide, square aesthetic of the header.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty urban scene with three men in street attire standing in front of a brick building with boarded windows. Include a blue street sign in the upper left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add heavy, wide, black-filled sans-serif text with white and red outlines at the top and bottom. Flank the bottom text with black lion silhouettes.

verificationChecks: Street sign is visible in the background
High contrast photographic style is maintained

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the busy background
Verify the lion silhouettes are solid black
Check that the street sign looks integrated into the scene
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Brick Background + Heavy Outlined Sans-Serif + Heraldic Accents
